name: Paygent Connect
description: Unclear: supplied sources cover a different Paygent (LLM cost tracking), not NMI-powered Paygent Connect.
auth_notes: Sources document auth only for unrelated Paygent products (Bearer pg_live key; paygent-api-key header). Nothing establishes auth for NMI-powered Paygent Connect.
gate_detail: No source describes how to obtain credentials for Paygent Connect (NMI-powered). Unrelated Paygent LLM-cost products let developers mint keys via API or dashboard, but that is not the target product.
api_scope: No evidence about a Paygent Connect API; the sources describe REST APIs of different, unrelated Paygent products.
mcp_notes: No source mentions an MCP server for Paygent Connect.
blocker_detail: All sources describe other products named Paygent (LLM spend control and AI billing), not the NMI-powered Paygent Connect payments product.

evidence.quote: Paygent is an SDK — for Python and TypeScript — that tracks per-user LLM costs and enforces spending limits before calls reach OpenAI or Anthropic.
Usage tracking alone does not invoice customers. Create an order to start automatic billing:
API keys authenticate the usage-tracking service. Managing them requires a signed-in session.

issues: Sources are all for different Paygent products, none for NMI-powered Paygent Connect.
Auth, access, webhooks, sandbox and MCP for the target product are unknown.
No quote genuinely supports auth or access for the target app, so none is tagged as such.
